error_job_not_cancellable: Not cancelled: nothing in it is still to come.
error_job_cancelled: This job was cancelled. Submit the link again to download it.
error_archive_nothing_selected: No jobs were chosen to archive
error_library_sort_running: A library sort is already running
error_library_path_not_absolute: {field} must be a full path, starting with /.
error_library_path_invalid: {field} holds a character no folder path can contain.
error_library_dir_outside_mount: {field} must be {mount} or a folder inside it: that's where the library is mounted.
error_library_quarantine_outside_mount: {field} must be inside {mount}: that's where the downloads volume is mounted, and anything kept elsewhere is lost when the app is recreated.
error_library_paths_overlap: These folders overlap; a sweep would move files onto themselves.
error_library_paths_library_downloads_eq: The library folder can't be the downloads folder.
error_library_paths_library_downloads_in: The library folder can't be inside the downloads folder.
error_library_paths_library_downloads_co: The library folder can't contain the downloads folder.
error_library_paths_quarantine_library_e: The quarantine folder can't be the library folder.
error_library_paths_quarantine_library_i: The quarantine folder can't be inside the library folder.
error_library_paths_quarantine_library_c: The quarantine folder can't contain the library folder.
error_library_paths_quarantine_downloads: The quarantine folder can't be the downloads folder itself; a folder inside it is fine.
The quarantine folder can't contain the downloads folder.
error_job_archived: Job is archived; unarchive it first
error_retry_cooldown: “retry now” works once per wait. Next try in {time}.
error_retry_cooldown_due: “retry now” works once per wait. This track goes on the next pass.
error_retry_cooldown_paused: “retry now” works once per wait. Downloads are paused; it’s tried once they resume.
error_file_empty: Downloaded file was empty -- the download did not complete.
error_proxy_target_exists_file: There is already a proxy for {target}. One address takes one credential: change it in proxies.txt.
error_proxy_target_exists_manual: There is already a proxy for {target}. One address takes one credential: delete that one first.
error_proxy_url_invalid: Proxy URL must look like http(s)://[user:pass@]<ipv4>[:port]
error_proxy_url_exists: A proxy with this URL already exists
error_alerts_not_configured: Matrix alerts are not configured (set MATRIX_HOMESERVER_URL, MATRIX_ACCESS_TOKEN and MATRIX_ROOM_ID)
error_retention_out_of_range: Enter a whole number of days from {min} to {max}.
layout_unreachable_body: This page tries again by itself. Downloads run on the server and don't need it open.
login_hint: Sign in with your vb2007.hu account. Access is by invitation.
login_session_ended: Your session ended. Sign in again.
login_error_rejected: Couldn't sign in with that email and password. Check both and try again. If they're right, this account may not be invited, or the account service may be down.
login_error_unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
login_error_server: The sign-in service had a problem. Try again in a minute.
login_error_rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
account_retention_hint: Finished jobs (done, failed or cancelled) are archived once nothing has happened in them for this long. Archived jobs are hidden, never deleted, and come back with “show archived”. A job still downloading or waiting is never archived.
account_retention_days_invalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to {max}.
account_keyboard_hint: Single keys do things on the queue: <kbd>j</kbd> and <kbd>k</kbd> move between rows, <kbd>x</kbd> cancels, <kbd>h</kbd> lists them all. Switch them off if they get in the way of a screen reader or speech input. Tab, the arrow keys, Enter and Esc work either way.
account_language_hint: The language this app speaks to you once you're signed in, on every device. Automatic follows your browser, as it always does when you're signed out.
track_status_lookup_failed: won't retry on its own · retry now to try again
track_status_lookup_failed_job_cancelled: won't retry: its job was cancelled
track_cancel_body_downloading: The download in progress finishes, but the track stays cancelled. This can't be undone, but the link can be submitted again.
track_cancel_body: It won't be downloaded. This can't be undone, but the link can be submitted again.
track_notice_not_cancelled_unchecked: Not cancelled: couldn't check the track first. Try again.
track_notice_not_cancelled_settled: Not cancelled: it isn't waiting to download any more.
track_notice_cancelled_while_downloading: Cancelled. It had started downloading; that finishes but stays cancelled.
track_notice_retry_held: held — global pause is active, will dispatch once it clears
track_notice_retry_queued: queued — dispatching on the next pass
track_history_refresh_failed: showing the last loaded history · couldn't refresh: {error}
job_cancel_body: Its tracks that haven't downloaded yet are cancelled; one downloading right now finishes but stays cancelled. Tracks not found stay as they are, and files already downloaded stay. This can't be undone, but the link can be submitted again.
job_notice_not_cancelled: Not cancelled: nothing in it is still to come.
job_notice_bumped: bumped to front of the queue
job_tracks_unreadable: Nothing could be read from this link, so the job has no tracks.
waterfall_stale_lost: link lost — progress may be stale
waterfall_holding_note: A deliberate pause after repeated rate limits. Waiting tracks keep their place.
waterfall_paused_note_admin: Nothing is dispatched until you resume it in settings.
waterfall_paused_note_user: Downloads resume when the receiver is switched back on.
waterfall_reconnecting_note: This page catches up by itself once the link is back.
waterfall_busy: no signal here — worker busy elsewhere
incoming_unreadable_track: no signal — could not read this track
incoming_unreadable_album: no signal — could not read this album
incoming_unreadable_playlist: no signal — could not read this playlist
incoming_unreadable_artist: no signal — could not read this artist
incoming_unreadable_search: no signal — could not read this search
incoming_unreadable_hint: Check that the link opens in Spotify, then try again.
incoming_cancel_moved: {message} It has moved into the queue below; cancel it there.
incoming_confirm_body: Its link is still being read. Cancelling stops what it would queue, and cancels anything it already has. This can't be undone, but the link can be submitted again.
incoming_lost_failed: Reading its link failed meanwhile; there's nothing left to cancel.
incoming_lost_moved: It's no longer being read: it moved into the queue below, or was already cancelled.
queuectl_clear_body: Every finished job of yours (done, failed or cancelled) moves to the archive, whatever this view shows. Archived jobs stay under “show archived” and can be restored one by one. Jobs still downloading or waiting are kept.
dashboard_submit_not_link: That isn't a link. Paste a Spotify link: it starts with https://open.spotify.com/.
dashboard_submit_many_links: That holds more than one link. Paste one link at a time.
dashboard_submit_placeholder: paste a Spotify link — track, album, playlist or artist
dashboard_empty_archived_hidden: Archived ones are hidden; show archived searches them too.
dashboard_reading_others: Another user’s link is being read
dashboard_reading_text: Its tracks appear here once Spotify has listed them, and each one downloads in the background.
dashboard_empty_all_text: Every user's queue is empty in this view.
dashboard_empty_others_text: This view leaves your own queue out, and every other user’s is empty.
dashboard_empty_own_text: Paste a Spotify link above. Each track downloads in the background, and a rate limit only means it waits its turn.
dashboard_empty_own_text_archived_hidden: Paste a Spotify link above. Each track downloads in the background, and a rate limit only means it waits its turn. Archived jobs stay under show archived.
settings_worker_hint: One worker downloads for everyone, one track at a time.
settings_output_hint: Used from the next download on. No restart needed.
settings_output_quality_untouched: YouTube's own {codec} stream (about 130–160 kbps), kept as is. Converted only if YouTube doesn't offer one.
settings_output_quality_mp3: MP3 is always re-encoded; best matches the source's bitrate.
settings_output_quality_reencode: Re-encoded to {rate}: smaller files, one more lossy step.
settings_output_template_required: Enter a filename template, for example {example}.
settings_library_hint: Where a sweep files finished downloads. Run one from the {link}.
settings_library_duplicates_hint: A download the library already has is quarantined (moved to the folder beside) or deleted. The library's own file is never touched.
settings_alerts_on_hint: Matrix alerts are on. Switch off any category you don't want; the same alert repeats at most once per the interval below.
settings_alerts_off_hint: Matrix alerts are off. Set {homeserver}, {token} and {room} in {env}, then restart the stack, to turn them on.
settings_alert_breaker_hint: Downloads hold after repeated failed downloads, and resume.
settings_alert_spike_hint: The latest attempts all failed the same way, within the window below.
settings_alert_beat_stale_hint: The scheduler hasn't ticked for longer than the limit below.
settings_alert_cooldown: Repeat an alert at most every
settings_alert_number_range: Use a whole number from {min} to {max}.
settings_alerts_test_sent: Test alert sent. Check the Matrix room.
settings_proxies_hint: Proxies from {file} and those added here are used equally, from a track's third attempt: after a direct IPv4 and a direct IPv6 try, each with its wait. Addresses are shown with their credentials hidden.
settings_proxy_add_invalid: That address won't work. It needs exactly {format}: a literal IPv4 address, letters, digits or _ in the credentials, and no path.
settings_proxy_remove_body: It's deleted from the pool, and no download uses it again. If a download is going through it right now, it's removed once that download ends. You can add it back later.
settings_proxies_empty: No proxies yet. Every attempt goes out directly.
settings_proxy_delete_waiting: {url} is used by a download right now: it will be removed once that ends, and nothing picks it meanwhile.
adminonly_heading: Only the admin can use this page
adminonly_body_settings: The worker, output, library, alert and proxy setup is shared by everyone on this server, so only the admin can change it. Your own preferences are on your account page.
adminonly_body_library: The music library is shared by everyone on this server, so only the admin can change it. Your own preferences are on your account page.
adminonly_body_stats: Download statistics count every user's downloads together, so only the admin can see them. Your own preferences are on your account page.
library_sweep_hint: Moves finished downloads into the music library, into folders named by the folder template. The folder, the template and what happens to duplicates are set in settings.
library_confirm_body_quarantine: Every finished download not yet in the library moves there. A download the library already has is moved to {dir}. Your own finished jobs whose tracks get filed are archived; other users' jobs are left as they are. Nothing already in the library is deleted.
library_confirm_body_delete: Every finished download not yet in the library moves there. A download the library already has is deleted. Your own finished jobs whose tracks get filed are archived; other users' jobs are left as they are. Nothing already in the library is deleted.
library_confirm_body_unknown: Every finished download not yet in the library moves there. A download the library already has is quarantined or deleted, as set in settings. Your own finished jobs whose tracks get filed are archived; other users' jobs are left as they are. Nothing already in the library is deleted.
library_settings_changed: The library settings changed while you were deciding. Check them and start again.
library_already_running: A sweep is already running; its progress is below.
library_link_lost: Live updates lost. Reconnecting; the counts may be behind.
library_state_finished_unread: Sweep finished; its error list couldn't be read.
library_report_unread: Couldn't read the list of files that weren't filed; reload to see it.
library_reconnected_unread: Reconnected, but couldn't re-read the sweep; reload to be sure.
library_retry_unreachable: tried again at {time}: could not reach the server.
library_nothing_to_move: Nothing to move: no download was waiting to go into the library.
library_cancel_confirm_body: It stops after the file it's on. Files already filed stay in the library, and their tracks follow them; the rest stay in downloads for the next sweep.

match.countPlural=one: Cancelled after {processed} of {total} file; the rest wait for the next sweep.
match.countPlural=*: Cancelled after {processed} of {total} files; the rest wait for the next sweep.

library_sweep_problems_hint: Not about one file: the sweep itself hit these (bookkeeping after the moves, or a crash). Files it already filed stay filed.
library_not_filed_hint: The sweep hit an error on each of these; the reason says what. Nothing already in the library was deleted.
worker_sentence_holding: Holding after repeated failed downloads until {time}.
worker_pause_confirm_body: Nothing new starts, for any user, until you resume. A download already running finishes; tracks that come due meanwhile are held and tried again later.
worker_release_confirm_body_paused: The hold ends now. Downloads stay paused until you resume them, and then start while YouTube may still be rate-limiting this server.
worker_release_confirm_body_running: Tracks that are due start again on the next pass, while YouTube may still be rate-limiting this server, which is what the hold protects against.
worker_release_confirm_clears: It clears on its own at {time}.
worker_release_check_failed: Nothing was released. Couldn't check the hold first: {reason}
worker_note_new_hold: A new hold began while you were deciding; nothing was released.
worker_note_hold_ended: The hold had already ended; nothing was released.
worker_read_failed: Trying again every few seconds. Couldn't read the worker: {error}
worker_state_paused_note: Nothing new starts, for anyone, until you resume.
worker_state_running_note: Tracks start as they come due, one at a time.
worker_hold_note: A deliberate pause after five failed downloads in a row, usually a rate limit. Waiting tracks keep their place.
worker_refresh_failed: Showing the last reading. Couldn't refresh: {error}
kbd_escape: Close a dialog, collapse the row, or clear the search
kbd_last: Last row; on the last row, load more
kbd_expand: Open the row; on an open job, move into its tracks
kbd_collapse: Close the row, or go back from a track to its job
kbd_cancel: Cancel the job or track (asks first)
kbd_bump: Bump the job to the front
kbd_priority_up: Raise the job’s priority by one
kbd_priority_down: Lower the job’s priority by one
kbd_repeats: Open the track’s history and show or hide every repeat
kbd_filters: Go to the filters (arrows move, Space toggles)
kbd_view_cycle: Next view: mine, all users, other users
help_layout_note: Keys as they sit on a Hungarian keyboard. A symbol shows the keys that type it there; on a US keyboard <kbd>?</kbd> and <kbd>/</kbd> are where you expect them.
help_off: Single-key shortcuts are off. Tab, the arrows, Enter, Space and Esc still work. Turn them back on in {account}.
stats_oldest_waiting: Oldest waiting track was submitted {age} ago ({when}).
stats_now_holding_detail: after repeated rate limits; waiting tracks keep their place
stats_rate_definition: Success is completed ÷ (completed + failed). Not found is a verdict on the track, not the route, so it's counted apart.
stats_no_attempts: No download attempts in this window.
stats_no_proxies_detail: No proxies configured. Downloads go out directly; proxies are added in settings.
stats_breaker_no_hold: The breaker didn’t hold in this window.

match.countPlural=one: The breaker held {span} in total, {n} trip started in this window.
match.countPlural=*: The breaker held {span} in total, {n} trips started in this window.

match.countPlural=one: Columns share one scale: the tallest is {n} failure in one hour.
match.countPlural=*: Columns share one scale: the tallest is {n} failures in one hour.

match.countPlural=one: Columns share one scale: the tallest is {n} failure in one day.
match.countPlural=*: Columns share one scale: the tallest is {n} failures in one day.

stats_no_failed_attempts: No failed attempts in this window.
stats_tables_label: Failures and breaker holds as tables
stats_table_caption_hour: Failures by type per hour, and whether the breaker held
stats_table_caption_day: Failures by type per day, and whether the breaker held
error_server_error: The server had a problem ({status}). Try again in a moment.
account_clock_hint: How times read across the app once you're signed in, on every device. Automatic follows your browser's region, as it always does when you're signed out.

match.countPlural=one: Too many tries. Try again in {n} second.
match.countPlural=*: Too many tries. Try again in {n} seconds.

error_api_key_label_invalid: Give the key a name of up to {max} characters
error_api_key_limit_reached: You already have {max} keys; revoke one first
account_keys_hint: The spotdl-web Firefox extension uses your sign-in in this browser when it can. Where it can't, give it a key. A key can only queue Spotify links, follow how they're doing and say whose it is: it never opens anything else, admin pages included.
account_keys_new_hint: Copy it into the extension now. It isn't shown again: if you lose it, revoke it and create another.
account_keys_copy_failed: Couldn't copy; select the key and copy it yourself.
account_keys_revoke_body: Whatever uses it stops working at once. A revoked key can't be brought back; create a new one instead.
account_keys_limit: That's as many keys as you can have; revoke one to create another.
dashboard_submit_already_queued: Already in your queue: that link is still downloading.
dashboard_submit_added_elsewhere: Added to your queue: switch to “mine” to see it.

match.countPlural=one: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {n} minute.
match.countPlural=*: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {n} minutes.

error_queue_unavailable: The queue can't take new links right now. Try again in a moment.
error_api_key_label_characters: A key's name can't hold invisible or control characters (often pasted along with text). Type it instead.
error_submit_too_long: That's too long for a link: at most {max} characters.
